title: 2023 Near Mint Pokemon Classic Collection 026/032	Professor Oak CLF Japanese
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after 2023 Near Mint Pokemon Classic Collection card features the iconic Professor Oak from the Venusaur & Lugia ex Deck. With a Japanese card size and a holographic finish, this card is a must-have for any serious Pokemon TCG collector. It is made of high-quality card stock material and is suitable for ages 6 and up. 

This card is a rare find and is sure to be a valuable addition to any collection. It is not autographed and is a promo card, but it is still highly coveted by fans and collectors alike. Manufactured by Nintendo in Japan, this card is a true gem for any Pokemon enthusiast. Get yours today!
